title: Add two or three one-minute movement bursts to the workday.
subtitle: Exercise snacks
rationale: Break sedentary stretches with stair climbs or squats hard enough to raise heart rate, no gym required.

evidence.summary: Small trials show brief vigorous bursts improve cardiorespiratory fitness and glycemic markers; long-term outcomes are untested.

indications: Deep-work days regularly pass with near-zero movement.
Structured workouts keep getting displaced by the calendar.
